mapper.select: SELECT ar.paper_id AS paperId, p.title AS paperTitle, p.total_score AS maxScore, ar.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, SUM(ar.score) AS totalScore, SUM(ar.correct = 1) AS correctCount, SUM(ar.correct = 0 AND ar.chosen IS NOT NULL) AS wrongCount, SUM(ar.chosen IS NULL) AS blankCount, COUNT(*) AS questionCount, ROUND(SUM(ar.correct = 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS accuracy, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(ar.submitted_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS submittedAt FROM answer_record ar JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id = ar.paper_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ar.user_id WHERE ar.paper_id = #{paperId} AND ar.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY ar.paper_id, ar.user_id, p.title, p.total_score, u.username, u.nickname
